items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Sneaked in the opera house to listen to Bert Williams

ctx.x: Sneaked in the opera house to listen to Bert Williams, and then they had--what's that other girl's name? Susie know, and I can't think of that lady's name--with the knowledge. She was a--Mama, what was the name of that other lady in the opera house?
